subject: Demo request: Private/VPC deployment for FinReg - scheduling
messages:
From: Sarah Johnson <sarah@finreg.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Private/VPC deployment for FinReg

Hi Marissa,

I signed up via the self-serve flow this morning and indicated interest in a hosted Private/VPC or on-prem deployment. We’re evaluating vendors for a regulated finance workload (PCI and regional privacy requirements) and would like a focused demo that covers networking, data residency, and audit/logging features.

A few items that are top of mind for us:
- VPC peering options and allowed egress patterns
- KMS/HSM integrations and key management flow
- Audit logs retention & access controls for SOC2 / internal audits
- Support for on-prem air-gapped installs (if needed)

We’re based in the US (NY) and I’ll loop in our security contact on follow-ups. Can you share available times this week for a 30–45 minute demo + technical Q&A?

Thanks,
Sarah Johnson
Director, Platform Security
FinReg LLC

Attachment: signup-summary.pdf (stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah@finreg.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Private/VPC deployment for FinReg - scheduling

Hi Sarah — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a focused session on Private/VPC and our on-prem options. I’ve suggested a few 30–45 minute slots here: https://cal.redwood.ai/marissa/30min (feel free to pick any that work).

Proposed high-level agenda:
1) 15 min product demo: VPC/private control plane, KMS integrations, and deployment options
2) 15–20 min technical Q&A with our SE (looped in) covering network and audit details
3) Next steps & security artifacts (SOC2 scope, network checklist)

I’m looping in Dev Patel (SE) who will join to cover architecture and network specifics. I’ll send our standard VPC/on‑prem checklist and a SOC2 scope summary ahead of the call so your security team can review.

Are you able to do any of the following this week?
- Tue 3/17 10:00–10:45am ET
- Tue 3/17 3:00–3:45pm ET
- Wed 3/18 11:00–11:45am ET

If none of those work I’m happy to propose more.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: redwood-private-overview.pdf (stub); vpc-onprem-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Thanks Marissa — I booked a slot via your calendar for Tue 3/17 3:00pm ET but our security lead has a conflict and asked if we can move to Wed 3/18 11:00am ET instead (that slot would work better for the team). Can you confirm?

Also, our security team would like to review any existing SOC2 artifacts and a brief network diagram before the call. I’ve attached our internal network diagram to help you triage questions on your side. If you require an NDA before sharing any artifacts, let me know and I’ll trigger it.

Thanks,
Sarah

Hi Sarah — Dev here, thanks for the network diagram. Wed 3/18 11:00am ET works for our team; I’ll send a calendar invite with a private meeting link and a short agenda.

Quick notes ahead of the call:
- We can present VPC peering & Private control plane options and show how KMS/HSM integration works (we support customer-managed keys via KMS).
- Our SOC2 scope summary is attached (non-sensitive overview). If you need deeper artifacts we can share via NDAs and a secure artifact transfer.
- Please have your security lead prepared with any specific compliance checklist items (retention windows, log export destinations).

Proposed additional attendees from our side: me (SE) and Marissa (AE). If helpful we can also invite a solutions architect.

See you Wed — invite forthcoming.

Thanks,
